title.zh: 界定菲律宾领海基线的法案
title.en: An Act Define the Baselines of the Territorial Sea of the Philippines

All waters within the baselines provided for in Section one hereof are considered inland or internal waters of the Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961.
